subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

David decided to ________ his old boat to get a new one.
solution:
David decided to '**sell**' his old boat to get a new one.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**sell**" means to give something in exchange for money. (बेचना)
 
• David wants to exchange his old boat for money to purchase a new one.
 
• The other options: "**sale**," "**cell**," and "**ceil**" are incorrect in this context.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 1**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *David decided to sell__ his old boat to get a new one.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Sale (बिक्री)**: means the exchange of a commodity for money; the action of selling something.
 
• **Cell (कोशिका)**: means a small room in which a prisoner is locked up or a small compartment in a larger structure.
 
• **Ceil (सील करना)**: is a verb meaning to line or plaster the ceiling of (a building).
